change: Grouped and scalar task fan-in now share a generic owned reduction scheduler. Grouped partial owners stay charged through callbacks and merges, and release after consumption or drained failure. New owned row/batch group-task entrypoints admit vector construction, ordering/top-k, offset/limit gathering and materialized rows. Removed legacy grouped state restore/merge/finalization and unowned shaping from this task path.

realFixtures: two concurrent grouped partials with delayed transport
transport rejection releases accumulated states and partials
final owned result holds reservations until release
descending order plus offset/limit returns expected group
maxOutputRows applies after shaping rather than rejecting intermediate groups
existing slice, empty result, partition group and residual fixtures continue to pass

tradeoffs: Full grouped ordering uses the admitted top-k kernel with limit equal to row count; comparative latency still needs measurement.
Rows finalize under ownership then convert via vectorFromSource; avoiding that intermediate representation remains a possible optimization.
remaining: Task planning and metadata ownership, partition-column construction and predicate scratch remain under review.
Generic owned aggregate vector/expression shape capabilities remain explicit; unsupported inputs raise capability errors.
Callback internal allocations are external even though all retained returns are copied under admission.
General spill/resume and full constrained mixed-job acceptance are not proven by these task fixtures.
